# kubesense_integration (Data Source)

Reads a platform integration by id, or by provider and name. Works for GitHub, which can only be connected in the UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# GitHub is connected in the UI; read it to reference its id elsewhere.
data "kubesense_integration" "github" {
  integration_provider = "github"
  name                 = "acme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Integration id.
- `integration_provider` (String) Provider, e.g. jira or github.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `config` (Map of String) Connection settings, secrets excluded.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the integration is in use.
- `integration_type` (String) native or mcp.
- `status` (String) pending, healthy or error.
